entities.name: Lac operon regulation
observations: In lactose without glucose, lactose-derived allolactose relieves LacI repression and high cAMP-CAP activates lac transcription.
Glucose reduces lac expression through catabolite repression and inducer exclusion, decreasing LacY-mediated lactose uptake and LacZ activity.

entities.name: Lactose
observations: Lactose induces the lac operon after conversion to allolactose and is hydrolyzed by beta-galactosidase to glucose and galactose.

entities.name: Glucose
observations: Glucose lowers cAMP-CAP activation and triggers inducer exclusion, reducing lactose permease-mediated uptake in broth C.

entities.name: LacY
observations: LacY transports lactose; glucose-mediated inducer exclusion inhibits this transport, especially in lactose-plus-glucose conditions.

entities.name: LacZ
observations: LacZ beta-galactosidase hydrolyzes lactose and its expression is reduced by glucose catabolite repression.
